title: Donut Battery 的锂质量分数会低于 0.1% 吗？

rules: 规则以锂质量分数低于 0.1% 为 Yes，达到或超过该值为 No。

interpretation: 需要能对应到被测电池的第三方成分证据；快充、能量密度或公司“无锂”说法不能替代成分分析。
Independent composition evidence must identify the tested battery. Charging speed, energy density and company descriptions do not establish elemental composition.

summary: 预测的是锂含量，不是测试会不会发生。原题的 Yes 门槛为质量分数低于 0.1%。
This predicts lithium content, not whether testing occurs: Yes requires less than 0.1% by weight.
checklist: 核对 Intertek 原报告的取样范围与质量分母。
Check the Intertek report’s sample scope and mass denominator.
区分送检组分、完整电芯与量产批次，确认它们和题目对象的对应关系。
Match submitted parts, complete cells and production batches to the contract subject.
对照原市场的后续澄清；报告结果不自动替代平台结算。
Review source clarifications; laboratory results do not substitute for platform resolution.

stage: 送检数据 → 商品验证 → 客户交付
Submitted tests → product validation → delivery
impact: 锂含量报告直接关联本题的化学门槛，比快充或能量密度宣传更贴近 Yes／No 条件。市场解读应从“哪种组分被测、是否对应题目电池”开始，而不是只看公司宣称使用了新技术。
The elemental report bears directly on the chemical threshold, unlike charge-rate or energy-density marketing. Interpretation starts with sample scope and correspondence to the contract battery.
gap: 一份送检组分报告仍需与题目对象、质量分母和创建者澄清对应。下方消息附近的价格对照只能描述成交，不能证明市场为何没有接受或采纳某项材料。
The report must match the contract subject, mass denominator and clarifications. Nearby prices describe trades, not why traders accepted or rejected evidence.

title: 美国电池级锂供应份额会在 2030 年底前超过 10% 吗？
Will US battery-grade lithium supply exceed 10% by 2030?
rules: 最迟 2031-02-01，有可靠来源确认 2030 年或更早某年，美国来源电池级锂产出占全球同口径供应 >10%。
By 1 February 2031, credible evidence must establish >10% of global battery-grade supply from US-sourced production in 2030 or an earlier year.
规则含本土矿山、回收和新加工设施，并用电池级 LCE；资料缺失或含糊则 No。
The body includes domestic mines, recycling and processing, using battery-grade LCE; missing or ambiguous data resolves No.
interpretation: 本题的范围比标题更宽：此前年度也可满足。矿山含锂量与电池级 LCE 不同；要逐项解释美国来源、精炼与回收，避免跨供应环节重复相加。
The body accepts earlier years as well as 2030. Mine-contained lithium differs from battery-grade LCE; US sourcing, refining and recycling must be reconciled without double counting.

summary: 本题的范围比标题更宽：此前年度也可满足。矿山含锂量与电池级 LCE 不同；要逐项解释美国来源、精炼与回收，避免跨供应环节重复相加。
The body accepts earlier years as well as 2030. Mine-contained lithium differs from battery-grade LCE; US sourcing, refining and recycling must be reconciled without double counting.
checklist: 记录满足门槛的年份与证据发布日期。
Record qualifying year and evidence publication date.
核对美国分子与全球分母的单位和等级。
Match units and grade in US numerator and global denominator.
区分实际产出、在建产能与资源储量。
Separate output, construction capacity and resources.

stage: 开采／回收 → 精炼认证 → 同口径供应份额
Extraction/recycling → refining/qualification → supply share
impact: 资源多寡和精炼工厂投产计划都只是供应链的一部分。USGS 的矿产统计能帮助定位原料与产出范围，但本题还要有电池级等级和全球同口径分母；一个美国厂区的总产能不能自动满足份额条件，回收和精炼同一批原料也不应算两次。

Resources and refinery plans cover only parts of the supply chain. USGS helps locate material and output definitions, but battery-grade qualification and a matched global denominator remain necessary. Facility capacity alone establishes no share, and recycled/refined feed must not be counted twice.
gap: USGS 主表未必直接给出题目定义的全球电池级 LCE 总量；若数据无法匹配，须保留缺口。
A USGS main table may not provide the contract’s global battery-grade LCE denominator; unmatched data remains a gap.

title: 日本会在 2031 年前用核能年产至少 1 万吨氢吗？
Will Japan produce at least 10,000 t/year of nuclear hydrogen before 2031?
rules: 2031-01-01 前，日本用核能直接制氢，年产量至少 10,000 吨。
Before 1 January 2031, Japan must produce at least 10,000 t hydrogen annually directly using nuclear power.
传统或先进核反应堆均可，至少两份独立可靠来源核实产量。
Conventional or advanced reactors may qualify; at least two independent credible sources must verify production.
interpretation: HTTR 的连接许可与 2030 年制氢目标尚不等于本题年产门槛。要核对核能输入、实际产量与独立确认，短时产氢或热源温度不能直接替代。

HTTR’s connection application and 2030 target do not establish annual output. Nuclear input, actual production and independent confirmation are required; a short run or heat-source temperature is insufficient.

summary: HTTR 的连接许可与 2030 年制氢目标尚不等于本题年产门槛。要核对核能输入、实际产量与独立确认，短时产氢或热源温度不能直接替代。

HTTR’s connection application and 2030 target do not establish annual output. Nuclear input, actual production and independent confirmation are required; a short run or heat-source temperature is insufficient.
checklist: 识别制氢设施与核能供电／供热连接。
Identify the hydrogen facility and nuclear energy link.
核对年产量而非额定容量或短时速率。
Check annual output rather than nameplate capacity or short-run rate.
至少两份独立来源确认，留存统计年份。
Retain at least two independent confirmations and reference year.

stage: 许可 → 核热耦合示范 → 年度生产
Licensing → coupled demonstration → annual production
impact: JAEA 的申请说明反应堆与化工设施连接仍需监管和工程工作，高温供热具有明确的技术用途。公告中的 950°C 和 2030 年目标可以解释路线选择，却没有提供每年一万吨实测氢产量；读市场时应把许可、首次产氢和稳定规模化生产分成不同证据阶段。

JAEA’s application shows the licensing and engineering work behind coupling a reactor to hydrogen production. The reported 950°C and 2030 target explain the route but do not establish 10,000 measured tonnes annually. Licensing, first hydrogen and sustained production remain distinct stages.
gap: “年产量”是否允许按短期运行外推，原文未细化；不能自行将额定产能认定为实际全年产出。
The body does not define extrapolation from short runs; nameplate output must not silently become actual annual production.

title: 2033 年前欧洲已投运专用输氢管线会超过 5,000 km 吗？
Will operating dedicated European hydrogen pipelines exceed 5,000 km before 2033?
rules: 2033-01-01 前，EU-27、英国、挪威、瑞士、冰岛与列支敦士登内专用氢管线运营路线长度须 >5,000 km。
Before 1 January 2033, operating dedicated hydrogen route-length must exceed 5,000 km within EU-27, UK, Norway, Switzerland, Iceland and Liechtenstein.
允许已转换投运的天然气管线；排除掺氢天然气、厂内管线及仅规划/获批/在建项目，各物理段只计一次。
Converted gas lines count once operating; blending, internal plant piping and planned/approved/construction projects are excluded. Count each physical segment once.
interpretation: 德国 9,040 km 获批规划与本题运营门槛不能直接比较。要按物理管段、投运状态和专用气体服务汇总，不以地图上的全部规划长度判定。
Germany’s 9,040 km approved plan is not operating mileage. Sum physical segments by commissioning status and dedicated service rather than every line drawn on a plan.

summary: 德国 9,040 km 获批规划与本题运营门槛不能直接比较。要按物理管段、投运状态和专用气体服务汇总，不以地图上的全部规划长度判定。
Germany’s 9,040 km approved plan is not operating mileage. Sum physical segments by commissioning status and dedicated service rather than every line drawn on a plan.
checklist: 保存运营商或监管机构的投运日期。
Retain operator/regulator commissioning dates.
确认专用氢服务并排除掺氢、厂内管道。
Confirm dedicated service and exclude blends/internal piping.
按路线长度去重，并裁切欧洲定义外的管段。
Deduplicate route length and exclude segments outside the defined area.

stage: 规划获批 → 改造／新建 → 专用输氢投运
Approval → conversion/new build → hydrogen service
impact: 联邦网络局的德国核心网络方案显示改造天然气管线在建设计划中占重要位置，但管材适配、压缩和转换运行仍有独立步骤。获批总长只是项目范围；只有符合本题地理范围与运营状态的实际管段才进入累计，不能把国家计划相加成欧洲已运营长度。

Germany’s regulator shows the role of repurposed gas infrastructure, with compatibility, compression and conversion still required. Approved length defines a project, while only operating segments within the contract geography enter the total; summing national plans does not establish operating mileage.
gap: 公开地图可能同时列出运营、在建和计划项目，须保存状态字段与截点，避免重复计数。
Maps can mix operating, construction and planned segments; preserve status/date fields and prevent duplicates.

title: NIF 在 2023 年的聚变能量比会超过原题“200%”门槛吗？
Did NIF cross the contract’s “200%” fusion-energy threshold in 2023?
rules: 原题限定 NIF 的 2023 年实验；背景以约 150% 和约 190% 的输出/到靶输入比较说明。
The source asks about NIF in 2023 and cites roughly 150% and 190% output/on-target-input examples.
标题用 net energy gain >200%，正文未给完整计算公式；保留原平台 No，不自行重新结算。
The title says net energy gain >200% without a complete formula. Preserve platform No rather than re-resolving it.
interpretation: 本题适合对照靶增益与工程增益的差别。标题的“净增益”与背景的百分比表达存在歧义，本站保留原判定，同时展示可核对的历史输入输出。

This archive illustrates target versus engineering gain. The title’s net-gain wording and background percentages are ambiguous; the platform outcome stays separate from documented historical input/output.

summary: 本题适合对照靶增益与工程增益的差别。标题的“净增益”与背景的百分比表达存在歧义，本站保留原判定，同时展示可核对的历史输入输出。

This archive illustrates target versus engineering gain. The title’s net-gain wording and background percentages are ambiguous; the platform outcome stays separate from documented historical input/output.
checklist: 确认实验日期与公布日期属于规则要求。
Check experiment and announcement dates against the rule.
明确分母是到靶激光还是设施耗电。
Specify on-target laser input versus facility electricity.
保留百分比定义歧义与平台结算。
Retain percentage-definition ambiguity and source settlement.

stage: 激光到靶 → 聚变输出 → 工程能量平衡
On-target laser → fusion yield → engineering balance
impact: LLNL 2023 年报告给出 7 月 30 日的 2.05 MJ 输入和 3.88 MJ 输出，使读者能自己核对约 1.89 的比值。它是一次靶实验，不含整个设施电耗；原市场的历史曲线、平台 No 与论文/报告能量值应各自呈现，避免把市场结算当成物理测量。

LLNL reports 2.05 MJ input and 3.88 MJ output for 30 July, allowing the roughly 1.89 ratio to be checked. This target shot excludes total facility electricity. The trade history, platform No and measured energies are separate records, not interchangeable physical evidence.
gap: 本题没有明确是输出/输入超过 2，还是净增量/输入超过 2；也没有定义设施电耗边界。
The source does not explicitly choose output/input >2 versus net-increment/input >2, or define facility electricity boundaries.

title: 企业团队会在 2024 年 2 月前实现 ≥99.9% 的并行双比特门吗？
Did a corporate team report ≥99.9% parallel two-qubit gates before February 2024?
rules: 企业量子计算团队须在 2024 年 2 月前公开报告至少两组同时运行的双比特门，平均保真度 ≥99.9%。
Before February 2024, a corporate team must publicly report at least two simultaneous two-qubit gates averaging ≥99.9% fidelity.
正文采用专家可信性判断，对 SPAM 是否可忽略保留未决表述；原平台已判 No。
The body uses expert credibility assessment and leaves SPAM treatment tentative; the source resolved No.
interpretation: 不能把单门峰值、单比特门或没有同时运行的测试当作本题达标。原文的企业范围和测试口径另需核查；现有 99.5% 中性原子论文只是比较材料。
An isolated peak, single-qubit result or nonconcurrent test cannot meet this contract. Corporate scope and benchmark definitions require review; the 99.5% neutral-atom study is comparison evidence.

summary: 不能把单门峰值、单比特门或没有同时运行的测试当作本题达标。原文的企业范围和测试口径另需核查；现有 99.5% 中性原子论文只是比较材料。
An isolated peak, single-qubit result or nonconcurrent test cannot meet this contract. Corporate scope and benchmark definitions require review; the 99.5% neutral-atom study is comparison evidence.
checklist: 核对至少两对双比特门同时运行。
Verify at least two two-qubit pairs operating concurrently.
检查平均值、误差条及 SPAM/泄漏处理。
Review averages, error bars and SPAM/leakage treatment.
区分学术作者与企业团队，并核对时间。
Match corporate versus academic attribution and dates.

stage: 物理门性能 → 并行操作 → 纠错电路
Physical gate quality → parallel operation → correction circuits
impact: 中性原子原始研究展示如何同时报告保真度和并行规模：99.5% 与最多 60 个原子需放在一起阅读。该结果低于题目 99.9% 门槛，且论文作者范围不能直接代替企业团队要求。它提供实验比较而不是对已结束市场的重新判定，也不是逻辑量子比特数量。

The neutral-atom study reports fidelity alongside scale: 99.5% on up to 60 atoms. This is below the contract threshold and does not automatically meet corporate attribution. It is an experimental reference, not re-settlement of the archive or a logical-qubit count.
gap: 原题正文对专家审查和 SPAM 处理没有固定算法，保持规则提示，不把不同测试结果拼接。
Expert review and SPAM handling lack a fixed rule; retain the caveat rather than combine incompatible benchmarks.

title: 2024 年底前会有商业太阳能电池效率超过 30% 吗？
Were commercial solar cells above 30% efficiency available by end-2024?
rules: 原题问 2024 年底前商业太阳能电池效率 >30%；正文指出叠层和钙钛矿是候选路线。
The source asks for commercial solar cells above 30% by end-2024, naming tandem/perovskite as likely routes.
正文未明确“商业可得”的交付尺度、面积与测试口径；封盘未判定仍保留未判定。
The body leaves commercial scale, area and test conditions underspecified; closed/unresolved remains unresolved.
interpretation: 本题没有把单片电池和组件效率解释清楚。Oxford PV 2024 年首发组件的 24.5% 不能写成 >30% 商业组件；实验室纪录也不自动满足商业条件。
The body does not resolve cell versus module boundaries. Oxford PV’s 24.5% shipped module is not >30%; a laboratory record is not automatically commercial availability.

summary: 本题没有把单片电池和组件效率解释清楚。Oxford PV 2024 年首发组件的 24.5% 不能写成 >30% 商业组件；实验室纪录也不自动满足商业条件。
The body does not resolve cell versus module boundaries. Oxford PV’s 24.5% shipped module is not >30%; a laboratory record is not automatically commercial availability.
checklist: 确认电池或组件、面积与稳态测试口径。
Identify cell/module, area and stabilized testing.
核对可供货证据，区分纪录与产品。
Separate certified records from available products.
保留截止与封盘未判定状态。
Preserve the deadline and closed/unresolved status.

stage: 效率纪录 → 产品认证 → 商业交付
Efficiency record → product qualification → delivery
impact: Oxford PV 首批商业组件与公司提到的 26.9% 组件纪录可以帮助分开“卖出的是什么”和“纪录测的是什么”。两者都不能直接满足 >30% 门槛；更不能把电池片纪录写成组件效率。原题仍需其指定范围的产品交付与测量证据，本站不根据后续报道自动改写结算。

Oxford PV’s first shipped modules and its reported 26.9% record distinguish a sale from a record. Neither establishes >30%, and a cell record is not module efficiency. Product and measurement evidence must match the contract; subsequent reporting does not auto-resolve it.
gap: “商业”没有数量或客户定义，且未规定认证面积与测试标准，按原文保留提示。
Commercial volume/customer, certified area and test standards are unspecified and remain flagged.

title: 2030 年底前单厂商钙钛矿组件年出货会达到 1 GW 吗？
Will a manufacturer ship 1 GW of perovskite modules in a year by 2030?
rules: 任一厂商在 2026–2030 某一日历年商业出货钙钛矿或钙钛矿/硅叠层组件 ≥1,000 MW，须有可融资认可的质保。
One manufacturer must commercially ship ≥1,000 MW of perovskite or perovskite/silicon tandem modules in one calendar year during 2026–2030, with bankable warranties.
研究组件、试验项目和缺少上述质保的室内光伏不算；合计多年或名义工厂产能不算年度出货。
Research, pilots and indoor PV without bankable warranties are excluded; multi-year totals and nameplate capacity are not annual shipments.
interpretation: 题目看单一厂商、单一年度和有效出货，不是开工或产线设计能力。标题写“2030 年前”，细则又将可计年份限定为 2026–2030，读曲线时须保留这一范围。
This asks for one manufacturer, one year and qualifying shipments, not announced factory capacity. The title’s broad deadline is narrowed by the body to calendar years 2026–2030.

summary: 题目看单一厂商、单一年度和有效出货，不是开工或产线设计能力。标题写“2030 年前”，细则又将可计年份限定为 2026–2030，读曲线时须保留这一范围。
This asks for one manufacturer, one year and qualifying shipments, not announced factory capacity. The title’s broad deadline is narrowed by the body to calendar years 2026–2030.
checklist: 核对厂商年度净出货及组件技术。
Verify manufacturer-year shipped volume and technology.
查看质保、客户验收与商业用途证据。
Review warranties, customer acceptance and commercial use.
剔除试验线产能、多年累计与重复申报。
Exclude pilot capacity, multi-year totals and duplicates.

stage: 试验线 → 可质保产品 → 单年商业出货
Pilot line → warrantied product → annual shipment
impact: 首批商业出货说明产品已进入客户应用，却未披露符合本题的年度 1 GW 总量。组件效率、年产能和实际出货各有独立证据；长期质保又涉及湿热、紫外和封装可靠性。把这些阶段分开，才能判断扩产新闻是否真正跨过市场设置的交付门槛。

First commercial shipment establishes customer use but not 1 GW in a qualifying year. Efficiency, capacity and shipments need separate evidence; warranties add damp-heat, UV and encapsulation reliability requirements. Expansion news alone does not establish the delivery threshold.
gap: 市场参与较少，且 bankable warranties 未规定具体年限；不把出货传闻直接计入总量。
Participation is low and bankable-warranty duration is unspecified; shipment rumours do not enter the total.

title: LK-99 的结果会在 2023 年内得到两次独立复现吗？
Would LK-99 receive two independent replications in 2023?
rules: 2023-12-31 23:59 美东时间前，须有至少两次与原作者无关联研究者的独立复现，可信来源与专家确认。
At least two independent replications unaffiliated with the authors were required by 23:59 ET on 31 December 2023, verified by credible sources/experts.
有可信度争议时可延至 2024-07-31 23:59 美东时间等待期刊结果；一份符合条件的期刊发表足以触发 Yes，原平台判 No。
Ambiguity can extend review to 23:59 ET on 31 July 2024; one qualifying journal publication can then establish Yes. The source resolved No.
interpretation: 本题复现次数、作者独立性和延期条款比“样品会悬浮”更严格。曲线记录当时的交易判断；原平台 No 与具体样品的磁性、电阻和相纯度分别阅读。

Replication count, author independence and the extension are stricter than observing levitation. The curve records trading judgments; platform No is distinct from sample-specific magnetism, resistance and phase purity.

summary: 本题复现次数、作者独立性和延期条款比“样品会悬浮”更严格。曲线记录当时的交易判断；原平台 No 与具体样品的磁性、电阻和相纯度分别阅读。

Replication count, author independence and the extension are stricter than observing levitation. The curve records trading judgments; platform No is distinct from sample-specific magnetism, resistance and phase purity.
checklist: 核对样品合成、相结构与杂相。
Review synthesis, phase structure and impurities.
确认独立作者与电输运/磁性证据组合。
Verify independent authors and combined transport/magnetic evidence.
按原截止、延期与发表条件读取平台判定。
Read the original deadlines, extension and publication rule.

stage: 合成样品 → 独立测量 → 复现审查
Synthesis → independent measurement → replication review
impact: LK-99 的复现研究需要把原始合成步骤、相结构和电输运测量连起来。既有研究中的杂相解释是材料证据的一部分，但不能将某一次样品失败泛化成所有材料的定论。这个历史市场增加的是明确双重独立复现条件下的成交记录，而不是把舆论热度算作复现实验。

Replication requires linking synthesis, phase structure and transport. Impurity explanations contribute material evidence without generalizing one sample to all materials. This archive adds trades under a specific independent-replication rule, rather than treating public attention as an experiment.
gap: 延期条款从两次独立结果转为一份期刊发表，且可信度由来源共识判断，需保留原文。
The extension changes two replications to one qualifying publication, with credibility decided by consensus; retain the wording.

title: 2030 年前获批药物研发会明确归功于 markov.bio 吗？
Will a drug approved before 2030 credit markov.bio’s contribution?
rules: 药物须获 FDA 或 EMA 人用批准，并有非 markov.bio 自身的可靠材料说明该工具对早期研发有重要贡献。
A drug needs FDA/EMA human-use approval and reliable evidence outside markov.bio attributing material early-development influence to the tool.
重要贡献含关键发现、显著提速或降本；公司退出早期药物发现业务可即时 No，归因不明确保留 N/A 裁量。
Influence includes an essential discovery or substantial speed/cost improvement. Leaving early discovery can trigger No; attribution ambiguity permits N/A at creator discretion.
